sentence: The room's canvas organizing restates in the model's terms (start/call/build/keep, neighbour deals, attack talk, close and record), but named unused concepts and themes carry organizing the model lacks: a host sub ruling on a requested portrait (c0099/P19), tracing a script that overwrote the mark (c0130/P06), moving plans through Discord (t08/c0109), explaining r/place to newcomers (t10/c0101), and turning Metal Gear lore into rallying (t09/c0114).
